text: ITEM 1 | Two strips of cooked meat lying side by side, slightly curled and overlapping at one end, reddish-brown to golden-brown with darker crisped edges and a glossy, slightly oily sheen; surface shows alternating lean pink-tan and darker browned streaks, flat and thin, roughly 1 cm wide and 10-12 cm long per strip, together covering about 12% of a 26 cm white square plate, sitting in the lower-center of the plate with no sauce or garnish | 25
